sessions.topic: Initial evaluation of a visibility-aware probabilistic SDF
sessions.boundary_reason: The benchmark meets both targets, prompting a move to held-out validation.

sessions.topic: Held-out calibration and reproducibility of the SDF
sessions.boundary_reason: Held-out results are reproduced; the focus shifts to testing the latents separately.

sessions.topic: Ablation of specular latents and visibility conditioning
sessions.boundary_reason: The ablation refutes regional independence, and a different reconstruction proposal begins.
The perturbation results support advancing p2 to a paired comparison with p1.

sessions.topic: Paired interval-width comparison of p2 and p1
sessions.boundary_reason: The paired comparison concludes, and mesh diffusion becomes the next proposal.

sessions.topic: Testing 32 mesh samples on multimodal occlusions
sessions.boundary_reason: Undercoverage motivates a revised sampling approach.
Coverage improves but the width target is missed, prompting another revision.

sessions.topic: Selecting 64 mode-balanced meshes after standard and perturbed tests
sessions.boundary_reason: A mesh-sampling choice is made, and the discussion moves to visual hulls and highlights.
The initial ablation supports highlight constraints; the next test changes to held-out moving lights.

sessions.topic: Highlight constraints under held-out moving lights
sessions.boundary_reason: The moving-light result falls short of the hypothesized gain, motivating compensation.
A decision retains highlights with stratified recalibration, before a new correspondence-based proposal.

sessions.topic: Initial test of epipolar highlight-track routing
sessions.boundary_reason: The initial boundary-occlusion result meets the targets; testing shifts to thin occluders.

sessions.topic: Fixed routing on held-out thin occluders
Comparing and selecting routing rules for thin occluders
sessions.boundary_reason: Default and perturbed-thin routing rules are chosen, followed by an audit plan.

sessions.topic: Routing audit and adoption of p5
